name: VirtualList
description:
Render large collections in a bounded container or inside ScrollArea. Only visible rows,
overscan and the currently focused row stay mounted. Give the parent a definite height.
Listbox mode uses roving focus; selection follows activation rather than scrolling.
signature: <T>({ items, getKey, estimateSize, renderItem, overscan, onEndReached, endReachedThreshold, loading, empty, role, selectedKey, defaultSelectedKey, onSelectedKeyChange, ref, className, onFocusCapture, onBlurCapture, onKeyDown, ...props }: VirtualListProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: Initial single selection in listbox mode.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there are no items and no loading row.

props.name: endReachedThreshold
props.description: Number of remaining rows that triggers onEndReached; defaults to 5.

props.name: estimateSize
props.description: Initial row height in CSS pixels, or a function of item and index. Rows are measured after rendering.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Stable identity for focus retention and React reconciliation.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading row after the items. While present, onEndReached is paused.

props.name: onEndReached
props.description: Called once for each loaded end identity when the visible range approaches it.

props.name: onSelectedKeyChange
props.description: Called when a listbox option is selected with pointer, Enter or Space.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Extra rows rendered beyond each edge; defaults to 5.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Row content. List mode may contain interactive controls; listbox mode should contain presentation content only.

props.name: role
props.description: List semantics by default; listbox adds single selection and arrow/Home/End navigation.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: Controlled single selection in listbox mode.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.
